verdict.rationale: TaxJar supports API-based transaction upload/backfill (taxjar-docs-1, taxjar-gh-3) and offers pre-built connectors for major processors/storefronts like Amazon FBA, BigCommerce, Ebay, Magento 2, Netsuite, PayPal, Shopify, Square, Stripe, and Woocommerce (taxjar-docs-9, taxjar-docs-19), consolidating multi-channel data for unified filing and nexus tracking (taxjar-docs-7, taxjar-docs-8). missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that connector syncs reliably backfill historical data across all listed integrations, and clarity on per-plan integration limits (taxjar-docs-20 caps at 10 integrations).
